1809-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1809-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2317-3899-4826-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

643-5256-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-5256-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s).
Repeat from step 3.

1545-1981-2415-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1545-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4971-7687-7690-7691.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4971-7687-7690-7691.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
The Thing triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
When the Wall enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

440-5796-6996-7426.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-5796-6996-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
440-5796-6996-7426.description:
Draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Well of Lost Dreams and The Destined White Mage trigger.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2

1453-5641-7306.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2469-4446-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2469-4446-5220-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1170-2440-4055-7499.description:
Cast the copy of Pest Friend from exile by paying {B/G}.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Lluwen, Exchange Student, which enters prepared.
When Lluwen, Exchange Student enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} each time for each Pest you control.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {C}{C}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat.

546-1409-4585-4613.easyPrerequisites: There are at least five total creatures on the battlefield.
546-1409-4585-4613.description:
Activate Custodi Soulbinders by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Custodi Soulbinders enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Custodi Soulbinders enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Custodi Soulbinders.
Activate Custodi Soulbinders using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

147-4050-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4050-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4050-7281.notes: If desired, you can cast Leonardo's Technique for its sneak cost instead, reducing the mana cost by {2}.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-3480-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5256-6528-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1477-2866-3200-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

2034-3558-5220-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

147-5256-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5256-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

252-2073-4779--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

345-3327-4613-5073.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
345-3327-4613-5073.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1479-5033-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-5033-5702.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

2438-2590-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2438-2590-5776.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2760-4279-5708.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
2760-4279-5708.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

997-1754-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Guan Yu.
997-1754-4766-5683.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Guan Yu.
When Guan Yu dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Guan Yu trigger, causing you to shuffle it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Guan Yu and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Guan Yu from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1374-3626-5223-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-5223-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

859-2999-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Lurking Roper.
859-2999-4702.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.

405-2232-4050-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
405-2232-4050-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double all tokens you make this turn.
Cast Resolute Reinforcements by paying {1}{W}.
When Resolute Reinforcements enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Resolute Reinforcements trigger, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Resolute Reinforcements to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldiers, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat from step 2.

3363-4782.notablePrerequisites:
Heidar does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
3363-4782.description:
Activate Heidar by paying {2} and tapping it, returning The One Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

1967-2440-4758.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Goblins.
1967-2440-4758.description:
Activate Ardoz by paying {3}{R}, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
The Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering Ardoz and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Ardoz trigger, giving the Goblin +2/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

802-1671-2493-3400-3620.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and the land with Gift of Paradise attached by tapping them, adding {G}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Ivy triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ivy from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and the land with Gift of Paradise attached.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and the land with Gift of Paradise attached by tapping them, adding {2}{G}{U}.
Resolve Snap, returning Archaeomancer from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and the land with Gift of Paradise attached.
Cast Ivy by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3613-3624-4050-4999.description:
Cast Flourishing Fox from your graveyard by paying {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Flourishing Fox, adding {W}.
Flourishing Fox is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Dress Down removing Flourishing Fox's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1656-4170-4762.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1656-4170-4762.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may instead use Fain's third ability to create infinite Inklings, then use Fain's fourth ability to untap Necrotic Ooze.
You then can also use Fain's first ability to get infinite +1/+1 counters.

2556-2665-4377.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Mnemonic Wall.
2556-2665-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the token Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
